Bready has invited {AccountData.NickName} to join the group.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Hello,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Bonne Bouche.
Bready?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: There's a question I've been meaning to ask you,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: so I made a separate chat group.
I see.
What should I do if she asks about the research...?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I'm pretty sure I saw someone

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: wearing a school uniform head into the kitchen earlier.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Could that have been an M.M.R. Vocational School student

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: who attended one of Crust's special classes before?
Ah yes, you're right.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Crust isn't up to any dangerous research, is she?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I seriously doubt she would,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: but she certainly seems more determined than usual.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: It's also the first time

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: she's invited an outsider into the kitchen during the research phase,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: so I was worried.
You don't need to be worried.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Okay, I trust you.
This whole situation must be frustrating for you.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Oh, well... hehe.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I'll just have to trust in Crust and wait.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: And besides, you're there with her,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: so I know she'll be all right.
That's right. I'll take care of her.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I trust you.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Let me know if there are any problems.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Bye.
